title: The Demoness Rama Didn't Want to Kill | Ramayana Ep 5

scenes.narration: Rama's first enemy had the strength of a thousand elephants. And he did not want to kill her.

scenes.narration: On the far bank lay a dreadful forest. Once, the sage said, this was the rich land of Malada and Karusha.

scenes.narration: Then a yakshi named Tataka laid it all to waste. Even now, no one dared to pass.

scenes.narration: Rama was puzzled. How could a yakshi hold such strength?

scenes.narration: It was a boon, the sage said, from Brahma himself.

scenes.narration: But when she and her son Maricha attacked the sage Agastya, his curse turned her into a man-eating rakshasi.

scenes.narration: To protect the people, cruel or not, sinful or not, a protector must act. That is a ruler's eternal duty.
So Rama twanged his bowstring. The forest shook, and Tataka came charging.

scenes.narration: Still, he told Lakshmana, I cannot kill her. She is a woman. I will only stop her.

scenes.narration: She raised a storm of dust, rained down rocks, then vanished into illusion.

scenes.narration: Enough pity, cried the sage. Dusk is near, when demons grow stronger. Rama aimed by sound alone, and one arrow brought her down.

scenes.narration: The gods rejoiced, and the cursed forest bloomed again. Next morning, the sage had a gift for Rama: divine weapons.
